jenny.name: Jenny
jenny.backstory: From a sprawling clan of blue-uniformed officers who look alike down to the last polished badge, Jenny patrolled highways and busy precincts for years with crisp discipline and zero patience for smugglers. When a trail of stolen wares drew her straight into Hollowmere's lantern-lit alleys, she stayed on to keep the harbor crowds honest—and soon found the house's manager far harder to stay strict around than any suspect. Dutiful on shift and disarmingly eager once her utility belt comes off, she keeps trouble outside the door.

design.hairStyle: hair swept into a spiky high ponytail with wavy side bangs
design.accessories: a blue-violet police service cap with a red band and gold badge, and white gloves

sig_jenny.prompt: a crisp blue-violet short-sleeved police jacket with a light-blue V-panel, red collar and sleeve cuffs, matching short pleated skirt, black utility belt with gold buckle and low-heel navy pumps

sp_jenny.prompt: a fitted navy leather moto jacket over a white tank top, dark jeans and black riding boots

unique.name: Kanto Beat
unique.desc: Her sharp patrols keep rowdy patrons in line, boosting security and keeping watchmen generous.

ivy.title: Professor
ivy.name: Philena Ivy
ivy.backstory: From a sun-drenched research station on Valencia Island, Professor Philena Ivy made her name studying rare regional anomalies—while quietly letting empty teacups and coastal field charts pile around her desk. Unhurried, sharp-minded, and immune to panic, she followed rumors of strange mana and sea-weary wanderers straight to Hollowmere. Between lazy afternoons soaking in the steam and sharp evening lectures that leave scholars hanging on every word, she prefers comfort over stiff ceremony—and treats curiosity with deliciously hands-on patience.

design.hairStyle: long, wavy hair falling past her shoulders
design.accessories: a thin gold pendant necklace

sig_ivy.label: Valencia lab attire
sig_ivy.prompt: a crisp white knee-length lab coat worn open over a fitted salmon-pink short-sleeved top, dark navy skirt and pink low heels

sp_ivy.label: Valencia beach swimsuit
sp_ivy.prompt: a sleek navy-blue one-piece swimsuit with a breezy white linen cover-up shirt draped open over her shoulders

juniper.note: Fellow professors who trade coastal field samples and compare hopelessly cluttered desks.

delia.note: Quietly grateful to the one person who clears her forgotten teacups without lecturing her.

cynthia.note: Shares dusty island folklore whenever the Champion drops by the study.

unique.name: Island Research
unique.desc: Her unhurried lectures make lessons stick better and entice scholars to spend freely.

kris.title: Trainer
kris.name: Kris
kris.backstory: Born in quiet New Bark Town, Kris crossed Johto from the Whirl Islands to the frosty summit of Mt. Silver with a travel pack over her shoulders and a notebook packed with field sketches. Too restless to sit indoors for long, she followed word of an uncharted port road straight into Hollowmere and talked her way onto the roster before unpacking her sneakers. Quick on her feet, endlessly curious, and fiercely loyal to anyone who matches her pace, she treats every evening like a sprint for the finish.

design.hairStyle: thick curved low pigtails with sporty bangs
design.accessories: a yellow-and-white visor cap and a pink travel backpack

clair.note: Still grins remembering the hard-won eighth badge she refused to leave Blackthorn without.

leaf.note: Fellow long-road travelers who compare worn soles and regional trail maps.

unique.name: Crystal Stride
unique.desc: Tireless on the street and quick on her feet, bringing more travelers to the door with energy to spare.

rosa.title: Trainer
rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.backstory: Raised in sunny Aspertia City before lighting up Pokéstar Studios' biggest soundstages, Rosa learned early how to hold every gaze in a crowded hall with one wink and a dramatic flourish. Between Unova journeys and late-night curtain calls, she boarded a ship for Hollowmere hunting new scripts, lively crowds, and a stage that stays bright past midnight. Expressive, bubbly, and shamelessly theatrical when teasing the people she likes, she plays the fearless starlet until you catch her alone offstage—where praise turns her ears bright red.

design.hairStyle: two large spherical side-buns with long twin tails hanging to her waist and yellow hair ties
design.accessories: a pink-and-white sporty tennis visor

phoebe.title: Trainer
phoebe.name: Phoebe
phoebe.backstory: Raised near the misty shrines and ocean breezes of Mt. Pyre in Hoenn, Phoebe grew up barefoot among carved stone lanterns, laughing just as easily with passing travelers as with the wandering spirits only she seemed able to hear. Between Elite Four duties and twilight island festivals, she followed a warm breeze across the sea straight to Hollowmere. Effortlessly friendly, fearless around the uncanny, and impossible to keep gloomy, she greets nervous newcomers in the foyer like old friends—and chases away every shadow in the hall.

roxanne.title: Leader
roxanne.name: Roxanne
roxanne.backstory: An honors graduate of the Rustboro Trainers' School and the Rock-type Gym Leader of Rustboro City, Roxanne believes every battle—and every ledger—rewards preparation and steady fundamentals. Polite, meticulous, and secretly thrilled by practical fieldwork, she arrived in Hollowmere with a satchel of annotated notebooks and fossil samples, determined to study how a well-run house operates from the inside out.

olivia.title: Kahuna
olivia.name: Olivia
olivia.backstory: The Rock-type Island Kahuna of Akala and a pillar of Alola's Elite Four, Olivia runs a bustling Konikoni City jewelry and stone shop when she isn't testing challengers. Warm, earthy, and unapologetically physical, she carries herself with the easy confidence of someone who knows her own strength—though she'll laughingly admit she came to Hollowmere hoping to finally meet someone who can keep up with her.

design.hairStyle: short, wavy hair flowing to the left
